fact_spine.statement: The event is Wednesday, March 3, 2027.
The performance is at Stern Auditorium / Perelman Stage, Carnegie Hall, produced by Troen Student Performance Events.
fact_spine.note: Describe it as Troen's performance experience at Carnegie Hall. Do not imply venue endorsement.

fact_spine.statement: The photographed licence states an evening session beginning at 8 p.m. with a stated duration of three hours.
fact_spine.note: The director FAQ carries the evening session but omits the exact start time and internal licence terms.

fact_spine.statement: The photographed licence page states a $26,460 fee due on signing, with other charges separate.
fact_spine.note: Not a payment receipt and not a full event budget.

fact_spine.statement: A DocuSign certificate identifies the March 3 agreement and reports completion.
fact_spine.note: The complete executed agreement is not included in the photograph. Do not reproduce signature identifiers in customer materials.

fact_spine.statement: The brochure lists a one-hour clinic at Boulevard Carroll Music Studios, a stage soundcheck, the concert, adjudicator feedback, an archival recording, a plaque with a rating or an optional comments-only treatment, an event shirt, backstage credentials, an ensemble base room, playbills and an assigned event director.
fact_spine.note: Shared March 3 / March 31 brochure. Inclusions are not guaranteed for a newly sold March 3 package until Troen confirms them.

fact_spine.statement: The brochure describes the day as clinic or rehearsal, soundcheck, concert, then awards.
The brochure says Troen has produced the concert for over 15 years.
fact_spine.note: A brochure claim. Corroborate before using it in competitive positioning.

fact_spine.statement: One group is reported as participating.
fact_spine.note: Identity, contract, deposit and performer count have not been reconciled. Do not name the group or show a payment ledger.

fact_spine.statement: Ten additional ensembles is a provisional target requiring capacity confirmation.
fact_spine.note: Not a verified inventory of ten slots. No live availability counter is shown anywhere in the demonstration.

fact_spine.statement: A large deposit is reported at risk; the cover letter describes possible repayment if the hall resells the date, less a fee.
fact_spine.note: Actual rights, amounts paid and remaining obligations need the complete agreement and business records.

fact_spine.statement: The working sheets use a 250 paid-performer target and separate fixed event commitments from per-person travel and package costs.
fact_spine.note: Some profit and occupancy entries appear unfinished; page 11 is an explicitly 2025 sheet with a different target.

fact_spine.statement: The documented clinic, performance and written feedback support an educational conversation with a director and an approving body.
fact_spine.basis: Drawn from the brochure inclusions in F06 and F07 and the materials strategy. It is a proposed framing, not a measured learning outcome or a school policy.

fact_spine.statement: No channel among existing relationships, tour partners and new public prospects has demonstrated better results for Troen.
fact_spine.basis: No comparative Troen conversion evidence exists in the supplied material, so the POC keeps the three channels level rather than assuming a warm-first order.

fact_spine.statement: The follow-up states shown in the demonstration are a fictional concert group, not any researched school's correspondence, approval, payment or booking.
No supplied item has been established as the final March 3 customer price, inclusions basis or booking cutoff.
fact_spine.needed_for: Issuing a firm offer, publishing a deadline, or using pricing in an external comparison.

fact_spine.statement: Current usable March 3 performance capacity and existing commitments are unknown.
fact_spine.needed_for: Publishing availability, holding space, or accepting a group.

fact_spine.statement: Applicable March 3 ensemble requirements and size limits are unknown.
fact_spine.needed_for: Representing a specific ensemble as accepted or eligible.

fact_spine.statement: The photographed licence names both Troen Student Performance Events and New York Invitational Music Festival; no reviewed source connects the public MTC calendar listing to this agreement.
fact_spine.note: The local name and date correspondence is supporting context, not evidence of an MTC relationship.

fact_spine.statement: Relationship ownership, prior contact history and permission to contact are unknown for every account in this case.
fact_spine.needed_for: Any actual approach, list handoff or CRM import.
